classes.name: index
classes.reason: In _consume the read loop explicitly checks `if budget_ns and probe.NS() - started > budget_ns: return staged, True`, so the index files must be read within the broadcasted time budget or the remaining reads for that unit are dropped, and since producers/idle ranks skip straight to the shared `barrier.wait()` while only the consumer performs `_consume`, every rank is held at that barrier until the consumer's bounded read (or early abort) finishes, and each specific index file is read exactly once per rank (`for p in range(PRODUCERS): for i in range(per_producer(cell)): staged.append(probe.read_staged(...))`).

classes.name: statistics
classes.reason: `_report` runs `for _pass in range(STATISTICS_READS): for p in range(PRODUCERS): for i in range(per_producer(cell)): probe.read_staged(...)` with STATISTICS_READS=8 and no time budget check, so a single rank synchronously reads each statistics file eight times before continuing; because every other rank is already waiting at the trailing `barrier.wait()` while the consumer executes `_report`, that access blocks the whole job even though it has no deadline.
